input_J.order_convention: stable dependency order (parents before children); explicit root interpretation, not a Fubini proof

ordinary_endpoint_admission.context: z1 > 0; initially 0 < Re(eps) < 1/8, then continuation to |eps| < 1/8
ordinary_endpoint_admission.argument: On the initial strip, the original adjacent endpoint densities are absolutely integrable. Their two endpoints each occur in one singleton gap; Fubini within this absolute-convergence domain gives exactly the displayed primitives and preserves the relative original order of all opposite endpoints. Each remaining opposite kernel uses a distinct endpoint pair and is comparable to u+v at its two zero corners. The finite primitive differences are bounded by sums of endpoint powers; at most two such powers supplement the kernel exponent. The product cube majorant is integrable uniformly for |eps|<1/8, including logarithmic derivatives. Thus M is holomorphic and its complete Taylor coefficient may be integrated termwise. This also specifies the meromorphic continuation J=prefactor*M from the initial strip.
ordinary_endpoint_admission.endpoint_interpretation: ordinary limits of each complete Taylor coefficient; no isolated finite parts
